summaryZh: Mertens Lab（主页正文称Neural Aging Laboratory）利用细胞重编程构建人类衰老模型，研究衰老如何影响脑健康和疾病，并寻找驱动人类衰老的关键分子，以支持年龄相关神经退行性疾病研究。
researchQuestions: 衰老如何影响脑健康及神经退行性疾病？
哪些关键分子驱动人类衰老，如何通过人类细胞模型研究？
topics: 年龄相关神经退行性疾病

evidence.quote: Neural Aging Laboratory Department of Neurosciences University of California San Diego
To understand how aging influences brain health and disease, our lab uses cellular reprogramming technologies to develop the next generation of human aging models.
We aim to use these models to identify the key molecules driving human aging, ultimately informing new treatment strategies for age-related neurodegenerative diseases.
